name: kaleido
vibe: a kaleidoscope come alive on deep violet-black: a slowly turning six-fold mirrored field of prismatic shapes, concentric rings breathing out from the core, a rotating spoke halo and a central mandala that unfurls petal ring by petal ring; headlines bloom open from the center, the accent word refracts through a three-hue prism ring, and scenes hand off with a faceted barrel turn — hypnotic, premium reveals for launches, art, music and anything that should feel mesmerizing. Its whole feel is driven by ONE hue, so it re-tints to any brand color.

sfx.style: glassy shimmers, crystalline chimes, soft prismatic whooshes and a gentle harmonic bloom on each turn — luminous and weightless
